messages:
alex_sales: Quick one 1 - Zenpath POC is hitting a nightly throughput spike. They asked if we can temporarily raise the Dedicated pool burst window to 60 minutes and allow up to 3 burst instances for the next 72h. Need confirmation by EOD so sales can proceed.

maya_pre_sales: Clarifying Q 1 - is this sustained traffic for the whole 60m or a sharp peak with taper? Pricing opt-in depends on whether it's burst credits only or we should advise committed burst.

alex_sales: It's a sharp peak + taper. Typical: 90150 RPS for ~3045m, then back to baseline ~80 RPS. It's for their nightly aggregation job only.

devon_infra: We can change the policy for that pool. Two notes: 1) burst credits consumption may be larger than expected if they parallelize across instances; 2) autoscaler cooldowns + instance spin-up times could create a short period of higher latency while scaling.

maya_pre_sales: I'll prepare a short pricing addendum. Estimate we should flag ~20% uplift over committed spend for the 3-day window until we get exact telemetry.

devon_infra: Draft config to apply (will need the pool id and an approved PR):

```json
{
  "pool_id": "zenpath-poc-2026",
  "burst_policy": {
    "window_minutes": 60,
    "max_burst_instances": 3,
    "credit_cap": 3000000
  },
  "autoscale": {
    "min_instances": 1,
    "max_instances": 8,
    "scale_down_cooldown_s": 300
  }
}
```

oliver_sre: Suggestion: add a short-lived routing override to prefer the eu-west region during the nightly run if Zenpath's latency reqs permit. Cuts token-dollar spend. Also, add an alert at 75% credit use.

carla_salesops: I can produce the contract addendum with an explicit credit cap and the uplift line item. @devon_infra can you run a back-of-envelope on expected credits consumed with the numbers Alex gave? Need a figure to include.

devon_infra: Back-of-envelope calc: assume avg GPU time per request ~0.09s, peak 150 RPS for 35m, using 3 burst instances -> GPU-seconds ~= 150 * 0.09 * 35 * 3 = ~1,417,500s -> credits ~= 1.4M (rounded). I'll refine once we have sample payloads.

alex_sales: I requested payload samples from the customer (ETA EOD). They said the job parallelizes across 2 workers by default, maybe more during test.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Provision request PR-20260318-991 created for pool zenpath-poc-2026. Waiting infra approval.

oliver_sre: @devon_infra when applied please add a temporary Grafana panel dashboard for p95 latency and burst credit burn rate, and set a PagerDuty trigger if credits > 80%.

devon_infra: Will add dashboard + soft cap. If credits hit hard cap we auto-revert to baseline policy and send notifications. Creating INFRA ticket INFRA-6138.

deploy-bot: [INFO] PR-20260318-991 status: approved. Scheduled apply in 7 minutes.

alex_sales: Please ping once changes live so I can tell Zenpath to kick off verification.

devon_infra: Applied. Pool zenpath-poc-2026 burst window now 60m, max_burst_instances 3, credit_cap 3,000,000. Monitoring enabled.

oliver_sre: Quick health check during spike: p95 generation ~520ms, no errors, credit burn trending as predicted.

carla_salesops: Addendum drafted & uploaded to CRM. Billing flagged for temporary uplift and credit cap.

alex_sales: Customer verified their nightly job ran and throughput was fine. They approved the temporary change. Closing after 72h monitor window. :tada:
